title: File:Reibekuchen frying on a large griddle, Erfurt Christmas market 2025.jpg
desc: Golden Reibekuchen (German potato pancakes) cooking in hot oil on a large flat-top griddle at a food stall at the Erfurt Christmas market, 30 November 2025. A vendor in a red fleece holds a spoon over the tray while a sheet of foil waits on the counter.

title: File:Weihnachtsmarkt Hildesheim.tif
desc: The commercial Christmas market in Hildesheim is held annually from late November to late December on the historical market place and is open daily. The photo shows the stall of fairground family Ahrend from the district of Hildesheim, which is modeled on a Erzgebirge Christmas Pyramid.
